<div class="card-body">
'''Lieutenant Cabbel''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">キャベル中尉</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２を加える。艦がタイラントなら装甲値にも１を加える。帝国軍のリーダーとともに戦闘する場合、相手の戦闘運命数の合計から１を引く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Lieutenant-Cabbel-PSA-84363905.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">カリダの士官学校を卒業したばかり。タイラントの一等航海士。野心的で冷酷かつ有能。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Lieutenant Cabbel.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If that ship is Tyrant, also add 1 to armor. When in battle with an Imperial leader, subtract 1 from the opponent’s total battle destiny.

'''Lore:'''
A recent graduate of the officers’ school on Carida. First officer of the Tyrant. Ambitious, ruthless, and able.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face names the ship as Tyrant for the armor bonus.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lieutenant Cabbel]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
